lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: My dad never called anyone to fix anything.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: If it could be done at home, he did it himself. And I was always one step behind him.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: Under our old white car, I held the torch. He held the wrench, and explained every bolt.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: From a few planks, he built the rekebot we still serve coffee on.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: When the power went out, everyone said: call someone. Dad just picked up his tester.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: And the whole house lit up again.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: A leaking pipe. A wrench. Patience. Then… silence.

lines.style: warm and unhurried, a quiet smile in the voice, a young man remembering his father
lines.text: Years later, he stopped fixing things for me, and started fixing them with me.
